notes.title: Patch Notes 9/18/2019
notes.notes:
Maintenance is underway.
Updated 2019-09-18 13:15 PDT (UTC-07:00)

There will be a maintenance today in order to patch the server to remove some ended event content (such as Melon and other NPC) refresh server applications and have rewards distributed by scripts which require a server restart. A client patch is being built at the time we will begin maintenance today. Unfortunately, it is unlikely to be finished before the end of maintenance today. It will be likely be applied tomorrow, Monday or next Wednesday. We will post an update to this schedule as soon as possible.

The maintenance will begin shortly after 13:00 PDT (UTC-07:00).

9th Anniversary Tokens will be removed and surprise gifts put in their place

notes.title: Honor System / Alternate Advancement Update Launched
notes.notes:
Notes on the Update:

Honor Points will no longer be earned as they were before by specific participation in a Battlefield or a Raid. Instead, Honor serves as an alternate form of Experience that puts more of the character development in your hands. New Builds incorporating the honor skills benefits are sure to arise and compete.

The system is available as before to all character on an account to use but character level restrictions have been introduced and the earned honor grade prerequisite remains to balance out the use of the system.

Keep in mind Honor Experience may be earned playing on a character at level cap or playing a level 1 and up on a reroll. All you have to do is toggle Alternate Advancement ON or OFF from the Character panel (default key: C) using the new button that was teased in early June.If the button has Orange text then Alternate Advancement is OFF and you will earn Character Experience on the character. If the button has Green text then Alternate Advancement is ON and you will earn Honor Experience on the account instead.

[url=http://www.playrequiem.com/notice/84200]Visit our notice page for more details.[/url]

notes.title: Update Maintenace at 3:00 PM PST 6/18/15
notes.notes:
Requiem Server will be going under maintenance for an update at 3:00 PM PST. 

Maintenance should conclude before 5:00PM PST. 

During this time Requiem will not be available. 

[h1] Patch Notes 176.2[/h1]

[b]Valdes, Bastion in Flames[/b]

[i]Valdes has been quarantined for the past few years. No one but the Holy Xenon Empire knows of what went on in the walled off city.

Once a prosperous city-state that rivalled that of Nova Lux, Valdes is now consumed with flames and destruction. It was the epicenter of civilization in the far reaches of Crescent, a beacon of hope for those that wished to reside in the harsh winters of the north. But, deep within the city lies a darkness that laid dormant for generations… [/i]

Valdes is a new open world field that is designed for players at the very max level. Within the dungeon, players will face difficult monster and undead that will require a party to advance.

Monsters within the walled off City will have a chance to drop new armors and Fragments of Dark Atma that can be compounded to create Dimensional Boxes that contain treasures.

[b]Mythic Doom Cheras[/b]

For Requiem's 7th Year Anniversary we are happy to announce the arrival of Mythic Doom Cheras. Much like his brother, Titan Ruinhorn, Mythic Doom Cheras is a revisited raid boss that has been tuned to match the current level cap and gear. Also like his brother, Mythic Doom Cheras will drop gear with updated stats!

Mythic Doom Cheras can be encountered by falling into the lava waterfall in front of his original entrance.

[b]Training Dummies! [/b]
The Ioxenic Organizations R&D Division has created genetically altered creatures to take in the brunt of attack without retaliation. Head on over the Grand Light Shrine and test out the new Dummies to see how much damage you can do!

[b]New PvP Jewel Rewards[/b]
Themed Battlefield Merchants will now sell new Weapon Enchantments. These enchantments can be compounded with the new Vial of Battlefield Blood Field of Contention Reward to make a stronger Enchantment.


[b]New Cash Shop Item: Random Stat Reroll Xeons! [/b]
These new Xeons will reroll stats of our new Mythic Doom Cheras items and Valdes items while retaining your reinforcements! Give them a try!


[b]Class Changes[/b]

Dominator -

[list]
    [*]New Skill - Summon Reaper
[i]Summons a high impact, short duration pet [/i]

[/list]

Druid -

[list]
    [*]Heavy Blow moved from Doom Guard to Inferno.
    [*]Thrown Vine moved from Battle Magician to Druid Doom Guard Tree.
    [*]Promise of Trust moved from Doom Guard to the Battle Magician Tree.
[/list]

notes.notes:
Dear players 

Server Maintenance was scheduled to begin at 10:00 AM PDT (UTC-7)
Server Maintenance is scheduled to be complete before 2:00 PM PDT (UTC-7). 

During this time Requiem will not be available. 

[h1]Patch Notes: 175.4[/h1]

Class Change: The next batch of changes for the Class Balancing will be the Warlord Class and some adjustments to the Warrior Class. With every major class change we will be doing a mandatory DNA and Skill reset for all classes.

[b]Warrior [/b]

New Skills
[list]
        [*]Iron Physique: (Passive) The Warrior gains a bonus in Max HP and Strength (STR).
[/list]
Changed Skills
[list]
	[*]Two Handed Mastery:The required levels to learn the skills have had been adjusted.

	[*]Dual Wield Mastery:The required levels to learn the skills have had been adjusted.

[/list]

[b]Warlord [/b]

New Skills
[list]
	[*]Art of War: The Warlord sacrifices Max HP for increased Max MP.

	[*]Warlord's Grip: (Passive) The Warlord hones his skills to do more damage with two-handed weapons in exchange for slower auto attacks.

	[*]Turtle-Like Shield: For a brief period of time, the Warlord gains massive bonuses towards Property Resistance and Defense.

	[*]Blood Carnival: The Warlord does a point blank AOE that deals physical damage initially and damage over time. This skill causes very high threat.
	
[*]Various new DNA have been added to the Warlord.
[/list]

	[*]Full Swing Slash: Damage has been lowered. Cooldown has been significantly lowered.

[/list]

[b]Events[/b]

	[*]Battlefields will be rewarding up to triple points!

	[*]Double EXP Bonus.

[/list]
Thank you, 

Requiem Team

"The Gutters"
